title: Show HN: Ex Situ – Open-source spatial index of displaced cultural artifacts
summary: Ex Situ is an open-source spatial index that visualizes museum artifacts as connecting arcs from their original origins to Western/Euro-American institutions that currently hold them, organized by categories like Islamic art, Asian/African art, and ethnological collections. Originally started as an MA thesis in 2022, the project continues development as a fully open-source, self-hosted solution under AGPL-3.0 license.
problem_solved: Traces and visualizes the provenance and current institutional locations of displaced cultural artifacts from their origin sites to Western museums.
why_valuable: Provides transparency and accessibility to cultural heritage provenance data, enabling researchers and the public to understand the displacement patterns of artifacts from colonized or historically acquired collections.
